achievements.name: First Follower
achievements.detail: Indoctrinate a rescued follower and give them a home in the cult.

achievements.name: First Sermon
achievements.detail: Preach at the temple and gather devotion from the flock.

achievements.name: Temple Ritual
achievements.detail: Perform a ritual at the temple to shape life in the cult.

achievements.name: Cooked Meal
achievements.detail: Cook a meal at the fire so a hungry follower can eat.

achievements.name: First Harvest
achievements.detail: Plant a crop on the cult farm and harvest it when it is ready.

achievements.name: Tarot Card
achievements.detail: Find a tarot card during a crusade and add it to your deck.

achievements.name: Doctrine Set
achievements.detail: Choose a doctrine and make that belief part of the cult.

achievements.name: Darkwood Bishop
achievements.detail: Defeat Leshy and finish the crusade through Darkwood.

achievements.name: Anura Bishop
achievements.detail: Defeat Heket and finish the crusade through Anura.

achievements.name: Anchordeep Bishop
achievements.detail: Defeat Kallamar and finish the crusade through Anchordeep.

achievements.name: Silk Cradle Bishop
achievements.detail: Defeat Shamura and finish the crusade through Silk Cradle.

achievements.name: Final Crusade
achievements.detail: Win the crusade's final battle and return to the cult.
